Moderate pale blue cytoplasm with indistinct borders giving evenly spaced nuclei
Marked reduction of granulocytic and erythroid maturation
Dark marrow particle and a megakaryocyte at lower left; numerous fat spaces
1209.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at low magnification is hypercellular and dominated by a monotonous population of small to medium-sized mononuclear cells with round to oval nuclei and moderate pale cytoplasm with indistinct borders, producing evenly spaced nuclei. Normal granulocytic and erythroid maturation is markedly diminished; a marrow particle and a megakaryocyte are present at the lower left. Cytoplasmic hairy projections cannot be resolved at this magnification, so correlation with higher-power morphology, flow cytometry (CD11c, CD25, CD103, CD123) and BRAF V600E is needed. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by hairy cell leukemia; note that many cases yield a dry tap, making an aspirate like this less typical.

ddx.vs: SMZL cells have more condensed chromatin and scant cytoplasm and are CD103/CD25/annexin A1-negative.
CLL cells are small with coarse block-like chromatin and scant cytoplasm, and are CD5+/CD23+ rather than CD103+.
Blasts have finer chromatin, higher N:C ratio and visible nucleoli, and express CD34 or TdT rather than a mature B-cell phenotype.
Mast cells contain abundant metachromatic granules and express CD117 and tryptase.

1145.recognize_zh: 周邊血中可見數個單核球系細胞，核呈摺疊、分葉狀或腦迴樣，灰藍色細胞質有空泡與毛邊，另有一個核呈環狀的小型顆粒球，提示急性單核球性白血病中的異常單核球。
features: Monocytic cells with gray-blue cytoplasm and irregular, frayed cytoplasmic borders
Nuclei folded, lobulated or convoluted with delicate chromatin
Cytoplasmic vacuoles in several cells
Fine azurophilic granules in some monocytic cells
Small granulocyte with a ring-shaped nucleus
Background red cells with rouleaux-like stacking
1145.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several monocytic cells with gray-blue, variably vacuolated cytoplasm with frayed borders and folded, lobulated or convoluted nuclei with delicate chromatin. A small granulocyte with a ring-shaped nucleus is also present. Red cells show rouleaux-like stacking in this area. The monocytic cells show atypical nuclear configurations and immature chromatin. Findings are suggestive of abnormal monocytes/promonocytes in the setting of acute monocytic leukemia; flow cytometry and nonspecific esterase are recommended to enumerate blast equivalents.

ddx.vs: Reactive monocytes have mature condensed chromatin, lack nucleoli and do not form a population of atypical promonocytes.
CMML shows persistent monocytosis ≥0.5 x 10^9/L with <20% blasts plus promonocytes, whereas acute monocytic leukemia requires ≥20%.
Sézary cells have cerebriform nuclei with dense chromatin and scant nongranular cytoplasm, and are CD4+ T cells rather than CD14/CD64-positive monocytes.

1081.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片一群細胞中有數顆核偏位、細胞質淡藍的漿細胞，其中幾顆細胞質含粗大紅紫色嗜天青顆粒（Snapper-Schneid顆粒），同時可見較大、染色質較細的不成熟漿細胞。
features: Cluster of plasma cells, some large and immature with dispersed chromatin and abundant grey-blue cytoplasm
Several plasma cells with coarse reddish-purple azurophilic cytoplasmic granules
Eccentric nuclei with perinuclear hof in the more mature forms
Admixed band and segmented neutrophils and fat vacuoles
Scattered free granules in the background
1081.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of plasma cells ranging from mature forms with eccentric nuclei and perinuclear hofs to larger immature forms with dispersed chromatin and abundant grey-blue cytoplasm. Several plasma cells contain coarse reddish-purple azurophilic cytoplasmic granules consistent with Snapper-Schneid granules. Neutrophils and fat vacuoles are present in the background. Findings are compatible with a plasma cell neoplasm with azurophilic granulated plasma cells; quantitation and clonality studies are recommended.

ddx.vs: Promyelocytes lack a perinuclear hof with clock-face chromatin, show Golgi pallor with nucleoli, and are MPO positive/CD138 negative.
Eosinophil precursors contain larger orange-red refractile granules with some dark basophilic granules and have granulocytic nuclear features.
Mast cells have central round nuclei obscured by dense purple-black metachromatic granules and express tryptase and CD117.

4217.recognize_zh: 低倍皮膚切片可見真皮淺層血管周圍與附屬器周圍的淋巴球浸潤，並有細胞散入表皮；此倍率本身並不特異，需高倍與免疫染色及 HTLV-1 檢驗佐證 ATLL。
features: Superficial and mid-dermal perivascular lymphoid infiltrates in a patchy distribution
Denser band-like infiltrate along a follicular/adnexal structure on the right
Mild focal lymphocyte infiltration of the lower epidermis
Epidermis with compact orthokeratosis and no significant spongiosis
Individual cell cytology not assessable at this magnification
4217.describe_en: Low-power H&E section of skin shows patchy superficial and mid-dermal perivascular lymphoid infiltrates, with a denser infiltrate surrounding an adnexal structure and focal extension into the lower epidermis. The epidermis shows compact orthokeratosis without prominent spongiosis. Cytologic atypia cannot be assessed at this power. In conjunction with higher-power morphology, immunophenotype and HTLV-1 status, the findings are compatible with cutaneous involvement by adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma; the pattern alone is nonspecific.

ddx.vs: MF also shows superficial perivascular and epidermotropic T cells; distinction requires HTLV-1 serology and clinical/blood findings rather than low-power pattern.
Reactive dermatitis lacks cytologically atypical cells on high power and usually shows spongiosis or interface change with eosinophils.
T-PLL cutis produces perivascular/periadnexal infiltrates of small-medium TCL1+ cells without HTLV-1 association.

4089.recognize_zh: 組織中充滿大型、多形性的腫瘤細胞，核呈泡狀、核仁明顯，並可見怪異的大核與核分裂像，呈現間變性（anaplastic）外觀；需以 CD20/PAX5 與 CD30、ALK 免疫染色才能與 ALCL 區分。
features: Sheets of large pleomorphic cells, many 3-5 times a small lymphocyte
Vesicular nuclei with irregular contours and prominent nucleoli
Scattered bizarre, multilobated or giant nuclei
Moderate to abundant amphophilic cytoplasm with discohesive growth
Frequent mitotic figures and apoptotic bodies
4089.describe_en: Sections show a diffuse, discohesive proliferation of large pleomorphic cells with vesicular, irregular nuclei, prominent nucleoli and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm. Bizarre and multilobated nuclei are scattered, and mitotic figures and apoptotic debris are frequent. The appearance is that of an anaplastic large-cell neoplasm; with B-cell marker expression (CD20/PAX5) this is consistent with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, anaplastic variant.

ddx.vs: ALCL shows hallmark cells with strong uniform CD30 and T-cell/cytotoxic markers but lacks CD20/PAX5, whereas anaplastic DLBCL is a B-cell lymphoma.
cHL has scattered Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells in a reactive background, CD15+ with weak PAX5 and absent CD45/CD20, rather than sheets of B cells.
Non-hematolymphoid tumors are CD45-negative and express keratins or S100/SOX10.

4153.recognize_zh: 低倍淋巴結免疫染色中，濾泡間區呈棕色陽性、寬大的同心圓套區陰性，中央小型退化生發中心內只有零星陽性細胞並有血管穿入，呈 T 細胞標記的分布；可看出 Castleman 病的洋蔥皮套區與棒棒糖血管。標記未標示。
features: Positive interfollicular zones with a T-cell-type distribution
Broad negative mantle zones arranged concentrically around a small germinal center
Small regressed germinal center with scattered positive cells and a penetrating vessel
Multiple follicles with similar expanded negative mantles
Low-power pattern only; cytologic detail not assessable
4153.describe_en: Low-power immunohistochemical stain (DAB; marker not specified, distribution typical of a T-cell marker such as CD3) on a lymph node shows positivity predominantly in the interfollicular zones, with only scattered positive cells within a small regressed germinal center. The surrounding broad, concentrically layered mantle zone is negative, and a vessel penetrates the germinal center. The preserved compartmentalization with expanded onion-skin mantles and an atretic, vascularized germinal center is consistent with hyaline-vascular Castleman disease.

ddx.vs: AITL shows expanded interfollicular atypical T cells co-expressing PD1/CXCL13/CD10 with extrafollicular CD21+ FDC meshworks.
Paracortical hyperplasia expands the T zone with immunoblasts but has normal follicles without onion-skin mantles or atretic germinal centers.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma, mantle zone pattern
ddx.vs: Neoplastic mantles are cyclin D1/SOX11-positive and CD5-positive B cells rather than unstained polyclonal B cells.

4153.stain: IHC: marker not specified (T-cell pattern, likely CD3), DAB

3897.recognize_zh: 腹水細胞離心抹片中，大部分是胞質充滿空泡的巨噬細胞；細箭頭指的細胞胞質深藍、核偏一側且核旁有淡染區（hof），是漿細胞，在腹水中看到這種細胞應想到骨髓瘤侵犯。
features: Plasma cells (thin arrow) with abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm, eccentric round nucleus, clock-face chromatin and paranuclear hof
Several additional plasmacytoid cells with dense blue cytoplasm scattered in the field
Numerous large vacuolated macrophages with folded or reniform nuclei; thick arrow marks a macrophage with engulfed material
Occasional neutrophils and small lymphocytes; rare red cells
3897.describe_en: Cytospin of ascitic fluid shows a mixed population dominated by vacuolated macrophages with reniform nuclei, one containing phagocytosed material (thick arrow). Scattered among them are plasma cells with abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm, eccentric nuclei with coarse chromatin and paranuclear hofs (thin arrow). Occasional neutrophils and lymphocytes are present. In a patient with plasma cell myeloma, findings are suggestive of myelomatous involvement of the peritoneal fluid; clonality should be confirmed by kappa/lambda immunostaining or flow cytometry (CD138/CD38).

ddx.dx: Reactive polyclonal plasma cells in effusion
ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are fewer, cytologically mature and polytypic for kappa/lambda, whereas myeloma cells are monotypic and may be binucleate or show nucleoli.
Mesothelial cells have central nuclei, a two-tone cytoplasm with a peripheral brush border/'skirt' and often form clusters, and they are calretinin-positive rather than CD138/light chain-restricted.

ddx.dx: Plasmablastic lymphoma or primary effusion lymphoma
ddx.vs: These show larger immunoblastic cells with prominent nucleoli, lack a myeloma history and are often HHV-8 or EBV positive.

3961.recognize_zh: 雙箭頭指的是兩端尖細、呈新月形的鐮刀型紅血球（sickle cell），單箭頭指的紅血球裡有小而圓的深紫色 Howell-Jolly 小體，反映脾臟功能喪失，兩者合起來是鐮刀型貧血的典型抹片。
features: Elongated crescent-shaped sickle cells with pointed ends (double arrow)
Red cell containing small round dense purple Howell-Jolly bodies (arrow), indicating hyposplenism
Several elongated/oat-shaped red cells and mild anisocytosis
Numerous platelets in the background
3961.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows irreversibly sickled red cells with elongated crescent shapes and pointed ends (double arrow), accompanied by oat-shaped and elongated forms. A red cell contains small, round, dense Howell-Jolly bodies (arrow), consistent with functional asplenia. Platelets are plentiful. Findings are consistent with sickle cell disease (HbSS) with autosplenectomy; confirmation by hemoglobin electrophoresis or HPLC is recommended.

ddx.vs: HbSC shows many target cells and blunt-ended, straight-edged SC crystals, with classic thin sickle cells being uncommon.
Elliptocytes are oval to rod-shaped cells with blunt, rounded ends rather than pointed crescent tips.
Pappenheimer bodies are multiple fine peripheral granules that are iron-positive, whereas Howell-Jolly bodies are larger, round, dense DNA inclusions.

exam.answer_en: Sickle cell disease (HbSS) with hyposplenism — crescent sickle cells with pointed ends and a red cell with Howell-Jolly bodies
pearls_zh: 考法：雙箭頭問 sickle cell、單箭頭問 Howell-Jolly body，接著問兩者合起來代表什麼：HbSS 反覆脾梗塞造成 functional asplenia（autosplenectomy）。
脾功能喪失的臨床意義：莢膜菌（Streptococcus pneumoniae 等）嚴重感染風險，兒童需 penicillin 預防與完整疫苗接種。
確認：hemoglobin HPLC／electrophoresis；sickle solubility test 在 sickle trait 也會陽性，不能區分 HbSS 與 trait。
治療：hydroxyurea 提升 HbF 減少疼痛危象與 acute chest syndrome；嚴重病例考慮 HSCT 或基因治療。
急性併發症：vaso-occlusive crisis、acute chest syndrome、stroke（兒童以 transcranial Doppler 篩檢）、parvovirus B19 aplastic crisis、脾臟 sequestration。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 elliptocyte 或乾燥拉長的紅血球當 sickle cell；sickle cell 兩端尖細、呈新月形，elliptocyte 兩端圓鈍，且真正 sickle cell 分布在抹片薄區。

quiz.q: 圖中單箭頭紅血球內小而圓的深紫色包涵體叫什麼？在鐮刀型貧血中代表什麼器官功能異常？
quiz.a: Howell-Jolly body；脾功能喪失（functional asplenia/autosplenectomy）

3833.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片中，骨小樑之間有一大片境界不清、由梭形至類上皮組織球與淋巴球構成的淡粉紅病灶，取代正常造血組織，屬邊界不清的肉芽腫。
features: Large, ill-defined aggregate of spindled to epithelioid histiocytes replacing marrow between trabeculae
Admixed small lymphocytes within a pale eosinophilic, loosely fibrillar background
No well-formed giant cells or caseous necrosis identified at this magnification
Adjacent uninvolved marrow with megakaryocytes and trilineage hematopoiesis (upper right)
Lesion abuts bony trabeculae
3833.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low power shows a large, poorly circumscribed aggregate of spindled to epithelioid histiocytes with admixed lymphocytes, replacing hematopoietic marrow between bony trabeculae. Multinucleated giant cells and caseous necrosis are not identified at this magnification. The adjacent marrow shows trilineage hematopoiesis with megakaryocytes. Findings are consistent with a poorly formed granuloma; in an HIV-positive patient, AFB and fungal stains with cultures are indicated to exclude mycobacterial (e.g., MAC) or fungal infection.

ddx.vs: Hodgkin involvement shows scattered large CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells in a mixed, often fibrotic background.
Mast cell lesions are spindled and paratrabecular or perivascular but are CD117/tryptase positive with aberrant CD25.
Fibrosis contains streaming fibroblasts with atypical megakaryocytes and increased reticulin, not CD68-positive epithelioid histiocytes.
Kaposi sarcoma forms spindle cells with slit-like vascular spaces and extravasated red cells, and is HHV8 LANA-1 positive.

3705.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片細胞密度很高，正常造血幾乎被一片片瀰漫的未成熟細胞取代，細胞核呈卵圓到梭形、排列成束狀，只在下方邊緣殘留少量紅血球系與出血區，左上角可見骨小樑；在移植後的病人身上，這符合急性骨髓性白血病復發浸潤。
features: Markedly hypercellular marrow with diffuse effacement by sheets of immature mononuclear cells
Cells with ovoid to elongated/spindled nuclei in a vaguely fascicular, streaming arrangement
Fine chromatin and scant eosinophilic cytoplasm; individual nucleoli not resolved at this magnification
Few residual megakaryocytes and small foci of residual erythroid precursors and hemorrhage at the lower edge
Bony trabecula at upper left; fat spaces essentially absent
3705.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low-to-intermediate power shows a markedly hypercellular marrow with loss of fat spaces, adjacent to a bony trabecula. The marrow is diffusely replaced by sheets of immature cells with ovoid to spindled nuclei, fine chromatin, and scant cytoplasm arranged in a streaming, vaguely fascicular pattern. Residual normal hematopoiesis is limited to scattered megakaryocytes and small erythroid foci at the periphery. In the clinical context of prior AML and stem cell transplant, findings are suggestive of relapsed acute myeloid leukemia; spindled morphology warrants immunohistochemistry (CD34, CD117, MPO, lysozyme) and chimerism studies to confirm myeloid lineage and exclude a non-hematopoietic neoplasm.

ddx.dx: Metastatic sarcoma or spindle cell carcinoma
ddx.vs: Spindled marrow infiltrates can mimic sarcoma, but relapsed AML is positive for CD34/CD117/MPO or lysozyme and negative for keratins and lineage-specific mesenchymal markers.
PTLD cells are usually round lymphoid cells or plasmacytoid/immunoblastic cells expressing CD20 or CD79a and often EBER, rather than myeloid markers.
Regenerating marrow shows trilineage maturation with erythroid islands and maturing granulocytes, not uniform sheets of immature cells.
Spindled mast cell aggregates are paratrabecular/perivascular with fibrosis and eosinophils and are CD117/tryptase/CD25 positive but CD34 and MPO negative.

3449.recognize_zh: 多顆紅血球內均勻散布著許多深藍紫色、粗大的點狀顆粒（coarse basophilic stippling），分布於整個細胞；背景另有標靶細胞。粗大嗜鹼性點彩可見於鉛中毒、地中海型貧血與嘧啶 5'-核苷酸酶缺乏。
features: Several red cells with numerous coarse, evenly distributed blue-purple punctate inclusions (coarse basophilic stippling)
Stippled cells are normal-sized to slightly larger with slightly bluish tint
Occasional target cells and cells with enlarged central pallor
Few red cells with a single small dark dot (Howell-Jolly body-like) and some with refractile ring artifacts
No nucleated red cells or parasites identified
3449.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows red cells with mild anisocytosis, occasional target cells and several erythrocytes containing numerous coarse, evenly dispersed blue-purple granules throughout the cytoplasm, representing coarse basophilic stippling. A few red cells contain single small dark dots, and some show refractile drying artifact. No parasites or nucleated red cells are present. Findings are consistent with coarse basophilic stippling, which should prompt evaluation for lead poisoning, thalassemia, pyrimidine 5'-nucleotidase deficiency or dyserythropoiesis.

ddx.vs: Pappenheimer bodies are few, small clustered granules at the cell periphery that stain with Prussian blue, whereas stippling is numerous granules spread evenly over the whole cell.
Howell-Jolly bodies are single, larger, round dense nuclear remnants rather than many fine to coarse dots.
Parasites show ring forms with a chromatin dot and cytoplasm, and Schüffner dots occur in enlarged infected cells with visible parasites.
Platelets and precipitate lie on top of cells in a different focal plane and are not uniformly distributed within the red cell.

exam.answer_en: Coarse basophilic stippling — numerous evenly dispersed blue-purple ribosomal RNA granules throughout RBCs
pearls_zh: 考法：指含均勻粗點的紅血球，問名稱、成分（聚集的 ribosomal RNA）與鑑別診斷（鉛中毒、thalassemia、pyrimidine 5'-nucleotidase 缺乏）。
鉛中毒：抑制 pyrimidine 5'-nucleotidase、ALA dehydratase 與 ferrochelatase，造成 RNA 降解障礙與小球性貧血；應查 blood lead level。
先天 pyrimidine 5'-nucleotidase deficiency 為非球形溶血性貧血，以明顯 basophilic stippling 為特徵。
背景 target cells 提示 thalassemia 或肝病；合併 microcytosis 時應同時安排 Hb 分析與血鉛。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 Pappenheimer bodies：stippling 顆粒數多、均勻分布且 Prussian blue 陰性；Pappenheimer bodies 顆粒少、成簇偏周邊且鐵染色陽性。

quiz.q: 圖中紅血球內均勻粗點的成分為何？最需鑑別的環境毒物是什麼？
quiz.a: 聚集的 ribosomal RNA；鉛（lead poisoning）

3321.recognize_zh: 血片中數顆中型淋巴細胞，核圓形居中、染色質中度濃縮，細胞質淡藍中量並有不規則小突起，符合毛細胞白血病變異型的腫瘤細胞；背景紅血球變形明顯（棘狀、碎片、橢圓形）。
features: Intermediate-sized lymphoid cells with round, centrally placed nuclei
Moderately condensed chromatin; nucleoli not clearly resolved at this magnification
Moderate pale blue cytoplasm with irregular, short cytoplasmic projections
Background marked poikilocytosis with echinocytes, elliptocytes and fragmented red cells
Occasional small mature lymphocytes and a granulocyte for comparison; platelets appear reduced
3321.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked red cell poikilocytosis including echinocytes, elliptocytes and fragments, with apparently reduced platelets. Several intermediate-sized atypical lymphoid cells are present, with round central nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin and moderate pale blue cytoplasm bearing irregular short projections. Nucleolar detail is limited at this magnification. Findings are consistent with circulating neoplastic cells of hairy cell leukemia variant in the appropriate immunophenotypic context (CD11c+, CD103+, CD25-, annexin A1-).

ddx.vs: Classic HCL is usually leukopenic with monocytopenia, has bean-shaped nuclei without prominent nucleoli, and is CD25/CD123/annexin A1 and BRAF V600E positive.
SMZL villous lymphocytes have polar short villi, more condensed chromatin and are CD103 negative.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: SDRPL cells have broad-based villous projections without nucleoli and express cyclin D3, with overlap requiring integration of phenotype and genetics.
Prolymphocytes have a single prominent nucleolus and lack cytoplasmic projections.

3385.recognize_zh: 中性球細胞質中有一條淡藍色、邊界清楚的長條形包涵體（Döhle-like body），但沒有毒性顆粒；旁邊可見體積接近紅血球一半以上的大血小板，是 May-Hegglin（MYH9 相關疾病）的組合。
features: Segmented neutrophil with a pale blue, elongated, well-demarcated cytoplasmic inclusion
No toxic granulation or cytoplasmic vacuolization in the neutrophil
Large platelets adjacent to the neutrophil and at the top of the field
Giant platelet with granular purple center and pale periphery
Red cells largely normocytic with minimal shape variation
3385.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a segmented neutrophil containing a pale blue, elongated, sharply demarcated cytoplasmic inclusion resembling a Döhle body, without accompanying toxic granulation or vacuolization. Large platelets are present adjacent to the neutrophil and elsewhere in the field. Red cells are unremarkable. The combination of Döhle-like neutrophil inclusions and macrothrombocytes is consistent with an MYH9-related disorder (May-Hegglin anomaly).

ddx.vs: Reactive Döhle bodies are smaller, paler peripheral patches accompanied by toxic granulation and vacuoles with normal-sized platelets.
Bernard-Soulier has giant platelets but no neutrophil inclusions, and shows absent ristocetin aggregation with GPIb-IX deficiency.
ITP may have mildly enlarged platelets but lacks neutrophil inclusions; MYH9 immunofluorescence shows abnormal myosin clumps only in MYH9 disorders.
Gray platelet syndrome shows large pale agranular gray platelets without neutrophil cytoplasmic inclusions.

exam.answer_en: MYH9-related disorder (May-Hegglin anomaly) — Döhle-like neutrophil inclusion without toxic changes plus large platelets
pearls_zh: 考法：同一視野放中性球包涵體與大血小板，考官要你把兩者連起來回答 MYH9-related disorder，而非感染。
遺傳：MYH9（non-muscle myosin heavy chain IIA）體染色體顯性；May-Hegglin、Sebastian、Fechtner、Epstein syndrome 現統稱 MYH9-RD。
臨床：macrothrombocytopenia 但出血多輕微；可隨年齡出現 sensorineural hearing loss、腎病變（蛋白尿）與早發性白內障，需長期追蹤。
避免誤診為 ITP 而給類固醇、IVIG 或做脾切除；自動計數儀常低估大血小板，需看抹片確認。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易當成感染的 toxic Döhle body：反應性 Döhle body 伴 toxic granulation 或空泡且血小板大小正常；MYH9 包涵體較大、邊界清楚並合併大血小板。

quiz.q: 中性球包涵體加上大血小板，最可能是哪一種遺傳性疾病？致病基因為何？
quiz.a: May-Hegglin anomaly（MYH9-related disorder）；MYH9

3257.recognize_zh: 骨小樑表面的淺凹陷（Howship lacuna）中貼著一顆多核巨細胞，約五個大小一致、分開的圓形核，細胞質嗜酸性，即蝕骨細胞（osteoclast）；可與單一分葉核的巨核細胞區分。
features: Multinucleated giant cell with about five uniform, separate, round-to-oval nuclei
Moderate eosinophilic, slightly granular cytoplasm
Cell sits in a shallow resorption bay (Howship lacuna) on the surface of a bony trabecula
Adjacent lamellar bone with an osteocyte in its lacuna
Marrow space with scattered hematopoietic cells and hyperchromatic lobulated cells (likely megakaryocytes)
3257.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy section shows a bony trabecula with a multinucleated giant cell applied to its surface within a shallow resorption bay. The cell contains multiple separate, uniform round nuclei and moderate eosinophilic cytoplasm, features of an osteoclast. The adjacent marrow space contains scattered hematopoietic cells, including hyperchromatic lobulated forms likely representing megakaryocytes. Findings represent a normal osteoclast engaged in bone resorption; increased numbers would suggest high bone turnover such as hyperparathyroidism or metastatic disease.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have a single large multilobated nucleus and sit within the marrow space adjacent to sinusoids rather than on bone surfaces with multiple discrete nuclei.
Osteoblasts are mononuclear cells with an eccentric nucleus, basophilic cytoplasm and paranuclear hof that line bone in rows during bone formation.
Granulomatous giant cells lie within epithelioid histiocyte aggregates away from bone surfaces and are not seated in resorption lacunae.
Tumor giant cells show nuclear pleomorphism, hyperchromasia and atypical mitoses, unlike the uniform bland nuclei of an osteoclast.

exam.answer_en: Osteoclast — multinucleated giant cell with separate uniform nuclei sitting in a Howship lacuna on a bony trabecula
pearls_zh: 考法：切片中指骨小樑表面的多核巨細胞，問「是 osteoclast 還是 megakaryocyte」；關鍵是「多顆分開的核 + 貼骨表面凹陷」。
來源：osteoclast 屬 monocyte/macrophage 系，由 RANKL–RANK 訊號分化；osteoblast 則為間葉來源。
臨床：osteoclast 增加見於 hyperparathyroidism、Paget disease、myeloma 等骨吸收增加；denosumab（anti-RANKL）與 bisphosphonate 抑制其功能。
Osteopetrosis 為 osteoclast 功能缺陷，骨髓腔被骨質填滿，可造成髓外造血與全血球低下。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為 megakaryocyte；巨核細胞是單一大型分葉核且位於髓腔竇旁，osteoclast 是多個獨立圓核並貼附骨小樑。

quiz.q: 位於骨小樑 Howship lacuna 中的多核巨細胞是什麼？其分化主要靠哪一條訊號路徑？
quiz.a: Osteoclast（蝕骨細胞）；RANKL–RANK

3129.recognize_zh: 數顆中型淋巴球，核輪廓不規則、有凹陷或腎形切跡，染色質中度凝集，胞質少且嗜鹼，邊緣有小突起（cytoplasmic blebs），符合T細胞前淋巴球白血病（T-PLL）。
features: Intermediate-sized lymphoid cells with high N:C ratio
Irregular nuclear contours with notches, indentations, and reniform shapes
Moderately condensed chromatin; nucleoli not conspicuous in this field
Scant deeply basophilic cytoplasm with irregular borders and small cytoplasmic blebs
Monomorphic population with no smudge cells
3129.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a monomorphic population of intermediate-sized lymphoid cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios. Nuclei are irregular with notches and reniform indentations, and chromatin is moderately condensed without conspicuous nucleoli in this field (consistent with the small-cell variant). The scant cytoplasm is deeply basophilic with irregular borders and small blebs. Findings are consistent with T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia; confirmation by flow cytometry (CD2, CD3, CD5, CD7 bright) and TCL1A/MTCP1 rearrangement is recommended.

ddx.vs: Sézary cells show finely folded cerebriform nuclei and typically lose CD7 and CD26, whereas T-PLL retains strong CD7.
ATLL cells show deeply polylobated flower-like nuclei, express CD25, and are HTLV-1 associated.
B-PLL cells are larger with a single prominent central nucleolus and more abundant cytoplasm, and are B-lineage by flow cytometry.
T-LGL cells have abundant pale cytoplasm with azurophilic granules and round nuclei.

2873.recognize_zh: 一顆巨大細胞，淡藍色細胞質中可見多個彼此分離、形狀不規則的核葉，為核過度分葉、分離的巨核細胞（megakaryocyte），可見於巨母紅血球性貧血。
features: Very large megakaryocyte with abundant pale blue, finely granular cytoplasm
Numerous irregular nuclear lobes that appear separated rather than compactly joined
Nuclear lobes with open, finely dispersed chromatin
Surrounding small dark erythroblasts and red cells for scale
2873.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large megakaryocyte with abundant pale blue, finely granular cytoplasm and numerous irregular nuclear lobes that appear separated from one another, with relatively open chromatin. Small erythroid precursors and red cells surround the cell. Hyperlobated megakaryocytes with separated lobes can be seen in megaloblastic anemia, consistent with the clinical context of pyrimethamine exposure, although this finding alone is not specific.

ddx.vs: Osteoclasts have multiple discrete round, uniform nuclei with single nucleoli and coarsely granular cytoplasm, rather than irregular interconnected megakaryocytic lobes.
MDS favors micromegakaryocytes and small hypolobated or widely separated round nuclei, with dysplasia in other lineages and clonal abnormalities.
Reactive megakaryocytes show compact, joined lobulation without the open chromatin of megaloblastic change.

2809.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片以一致的中小型母細胞為主：高核質比、核圓、染色質細緻、細胞質少且無顆粒，正常造血細胞明顯減少，符合前驅 B 淋巴母細胞白血病（B-ALL）；確診仍需流式細胞儀。
features: Monotonous population of small to intermediate blasts, roughly 1.5-2 times a red cell diameter
High N:C ratio with scant, agranular pale-blue cytoplasm
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with fine, homogeneous chromatin and indistinct nucleoli
No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules identified
Blasts arranged in clusters and singly; residual maturing myeloid and erythroid cells markedly reduced
Some smudged/crushed cells in thicker areas of the smear
2809.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular specimen largely replaced by a monotonous population of small to intermediate-sized blasts. The blasts have a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, round to slightly irregular nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli, and scant agranular basophilic cytoplasm. Auer rods are not identified, and normal trilineage hematopoiesis is markedly reduced. Findings are consistent with acute lymphoblastic leukemia; flow cytometric immunophenotyping (CD19, CD10, CD22, TdT, cytoplasmic CD79a) and cytogenetic studies are needed to confirm B-lineage and risk stratify.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: AML-M0 blasts may look identical and lack granules; separation requires flow cytometry showing myeloid markers (CD13, CD33, CD117) without B-lineage antigens.
T-ALL is morphologically indistinguishable and is separated by cytoplasmic CD3 expression and lack of CD19/CD79a.
Hematogones show a spectrum of maturation with more condensed chromatin and a normal maturational flow pattern, rather than a monotonous sheet replacing the marrow.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with prominent lipid vacuoles and are surface-immunoglobulin positive, TdT negative.

exam.answer_en: Acute lymphoblastic leukemia (B-lineage) — marrow replaced by monotonous small-intermediate blasts with scant agranular cytoplasm and no Auer rods
pearls_zh: 考法：考官問「lymphoblast 還是 myeloblast？憑什麼？」——答 lymphoblast：細胞較小、N:C 極高、細胞質少且無顆粒、無 Auer rod、核仁不明顯；但確定譜系必須靠 flow。
細胞化學：MPO 與 Sudan black B 在 lymphoblast 陰性（<3% blasts 陽性），PAS 可呈 block positivity，但不再作為分型依據。
WHO 5th 將 B-ALL 依遺傳異常分型（如 BCR::ABL1、KMT2A r、ETV6::RUNX1、TCF3::PBX1、hyperdiploidy 等），需做 karyotype、FISH 與分子檢測。
BCR::ABL1 陽性 B-ALL 在成人較常見，需加 TKI；p190（e1a2）轉錄本在 Ph+ ALL 比 CML 常見。
骨髓大量取代時 PB 可能出現 pancytopenia 而 blasts 不多（aleukemic），骨髓檢查不可省略。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把擠壓/smudged cells 或厚片區的小淋巴球誤計為 blasts，或把 Burkitt leukemia 當 B-ALL；Burkitt 細胞質深藍含空泡、TdT−、sIg+、MYC 重排。

quiz.q: 此骨髓 blasts 無顆粒、無 Auer rod。確定其為 B-lineage 最關鍵的 flow 標記組合為何？
quiz.a: CD19 加 cytoplasmic CD79a/CD22（或 CD10），合併 TdT/CD34 顯示不成熟；MPO 陰性

2745.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中數顆小至中型淋巴細胞，核質比高、染色質凝集，細胞質極少，細胞邊緣可見小的細胞質突起（blebs）；小細胞外觀但帶有細胞質突起，是 T-PLL 小細胞變異型常見的線索。
features: Small to intermediate lymphoid cells with very high N:C ratio
Scant basophilic cytoplasm with small surface blebs/protrusions
Round to slightly irregular nuclei, one with a faint nuclear cleft
Moderately to markedly condensed chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
Normal-appearing red cells in background
2745.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several small to intermediate lymphoid cells with very high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, round to slightly irregular nuclei with condensed chromatin, and scant basophilic cytoplasm bearing small surface blebs. Nucleoli are not conspicuous, as is typical of the small-cell variant. Red cells are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia (small-cell variant) in the appropriate clinical context; immunophenotyping and TCL1A rearrangement studies are necessary for diagnosis.

ddx.vs: CLL cells have coarse block-like chromatin without cytoplasmic blebs and are CD5+/CD23+ B cells.
Small Sezary cells have cerebriform nuclear grooves and are CD7/CD26-negative, unlike TCL1-positive T-PLL cells.
T-LGL cells have abundant pale cytoplasm with azurophilic granules rather than scant blebbed basophilic cytoplasm.

2681.recognize_zh: 淋巴球核幾乎占滿細胞，箭頭所指的核與細胞膜之間有一段細長、透明無色的棒狀空隙，就是細胞質內的結晶包涵體；核染色質有條紋狀淡區。
features: Lymphocyte with very high N:C ratio and nucleus filling most of the cell
Coarse chromatin with pale linear streaks
Very thin rim of pale cytoplasm
Elongated colorless rod-shaped inclusion between nucleus and cell membrane (arrow)
Adjacent teardrop and oval red cells; blurry enlarged image
2681.describe_en: High-power, digitally enlarged view of a peripheral blood smear shows a lymphocyte with a very high N:C ratio, coarse chromatin with pale streaks, and a thin rim of cytoplasm. A narrow, unstained, rod-shaped inclusion is present at the cytoplasmic edge adjacent to the nucleus (arrow). Nearby red cells include teardrop and oval forms. Findings are consistent with a crystalline inclusion in a neoplastic lymphocyte, although the blurred enlargement makes it difficult to exclude a retraction artifact on this single cell; identifying similar inclusions in other lymphoid cells supports the interpretation.

ddx.vs: Artifactual clefts have irregular outlines and vary across the smear, whereas crystals are sharply straight-edged and reproducible in multiple neoplastic cells.
Auer rods are stained pink-purple and are found in blasts, not as clear clefts in mature lymphocytes.
Hairy cells have abundant gray-blue cytoplasm with circumferential hairy projections and oval or bean-shaped nuclei rather than scant cytoplasm with a crystal.

2105.recognize_zh: 油鏡下嗜中性球胞質含較明顯的紫紅色顆粒，細胞右下緣可見一小塊淡藍色、無顆粒的胞質斑（Döhle body），核呈 C 形帶狀至分葉，是毒性變化中 Döhle body 的典型位置與外觀。
features: Neutrophil with band to early-segmented, C-shaped nucleus and clumped chromatin
Small pale blue agranular patch at the lower-right cytoplasmic periphery (Döhle body)
Increased purple-red cytoplasmic granulation (mild toxic granulation)
Background red cells with a few stomatocyte-like central pallor forms and refractile drying artifact
Normal-sized platelets in background
2105.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at oil immersion shows a band to early-segmented neutrophil with increased purple-red cytoplasmic granulation and a small pale blue agranular patch at the lower-right cytoplasmic edge, consistent with a Döhle body. Red cells show some refractile drying artifact. Findings are consistent with reactive toxic changes in neutrophils, as seen in infection, inflammation, pregnancy, or cytokine therapy.

ddx.vs: MYH9 inclusions occur in nearly all neutrophils, are often larger and more elongated, and are accompanied by macrothrombocytopenia.
A platelet sitting on the cell is granular purple with a defined border, whereas a Döhle body is pale blue, homogeneous, and within the cytoplasm.
Stain artifact produces diffuse bluish cytoplasm across many cells rather than a discrete peripheral patch.

exam.answer_en: Döhle body in a band neutrophil — small pale blue agranular peripheral cytoplasmic patch with mild toxic granulation
pearls_zh: 考法：Döhle body 典型位於胞質周邊，考官會指這塊淡藍斑並要你排除重疊血小板或染色假象。
成分為殘留的 rough ER（ribosomal RNA），故染淡藍；代表嗜中性球在刺激下加速成熟、胞質成熟不完全。
臨床意義：非特異性反應，見於感染、發炎、燒傷、懷孕、化療後或 G-CSF；帶狀核加毒性變化提示左移。
若多數嗜中性球都有較大、梭形包涵體，合併巨大血小板與血小板低下，要想 MYH9-related disorder，可用 NMMHC-IIA 免疫螢光確認。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把疊在細胞上的血小板當成 Döhle body：血小板為紫色顆粒狀、邊界清楚、常部分超出細胞；Döhle body 均質淡藍、位於胞質內緣。

quiz.q: 圖中帶狀核嗜中性球右下緣的淡藍色斑塊是什麼？若同一病人還有巨大血小板與血小板低下，應想到哪個遺傳疾病？
quiz.a: Döhle body；MYH9-related disorder（May-Hegglin anomaly）

2041.recognize_zh: 中間一排大型細胞細胞質塞滿紫色顆粒，核被遮住，數顆可見雙葉核、中間有摺痕（butterfly nucleus），並伸出淡藍色尾狀細胞質；與右下角顆粒稀少、核較清楚的正常單核／骨髓球系細胞對比明顯。
features: Row of large cells with densely granulated cytoplasm obscuring nuclear detail
Bilobed nuclei with a central crease (butterfly/sliding-plate appearance) in several cells
Tapered, teardrop-like cell shape with pale basophilic cytoplasmic tail in some cells
Adjacent normal-appearing mononuclear cell (lower right) with indented nucleus and pale cytoplasm for comparison
Auer rod bundles not clearly seen in this field
Background red cells with drying artifact
2041.describe_en: Smear shows several large abnormal cells arranged in a row. Their cytoplasm is packed with coarse azurophilic granules that obscure the nucleus, and several have bilobed nuclei with a central fold and a pale basophilic cytoplasmic tail. A normal-appearing mononuclear cell with an indented nucleus and sparsely granular cytoplasm is present for comparison. Auer rod bundles are not definitively seen. Findings are consistent with hypergranular acute promyelocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Normal promyelocytes show a visible round nucleus, perinuclear hof and less dense granules, and are part of a maturing spectrum rather than a monotonous granule-obscured population.
The microgranular variant has similar bilobed nuclei but sparse fine granules on light microscopy, unlike the heavy coarse granulation here.
Monocytic cells have gray-blue cytoplasm with fine granules and vacuoles and are nonspecific esterase positive, whereas APL cells are intensely MPO positive and CD34/HLA-DR negative.

exam.answer_en: Acute promyelocytic leukemia, hypergranular type — granule-packed promyelocytes with bilobed butterfly nuclei and cytoplasmic tails
pearls_zh: 考法：同一視野放異常前骨髓細胞與正常單核細胞，要求指出哪一顆是 APL 細胞並說明依據：顆粒遮核、雙葉蝴蝶核 vs 顆粒稀少、核輪廓清楚。
遺傳：PML::RARA 以 FISH（快速）或 RT-PCR（可定 bcr 型別並作 MRD 監測）確認；少數 cryptic insertion 核型正常但 RT-PCR 陽性。
細胞化學：MPO／Sudan black B 強陽性，nonspecific esterase 陰性，可與 monocytic leukemia 區分。
臨床：ATRA + arsenic trioxide 治療後長期存活率高，主要死因為診斷初期出血，因此重點在早期辨識與立即處理凝血病變。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 acute monocytic leukemia：單核系細胞核也有折疊，但細胞質灰藍、顆粒細小、MPO 弱且 NSE 陽性；APL 顆粒粗大、MPO 強陽性、CD34/HLA-DR 陰性。

quiz.q: 圖中顆粒密集的細胞與右下角細胞相比，做 MPO 染色結果有何不同？
quiz.a: APL 細胞 MPO 強陽性；單核系細胞 MPO 弱或陰性

1977.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中許多中大型未成熟細胞，核質比高、染色質細緻，部分核有凹陷或折疊，部分細胞可見少量嗜天青顆粒；同時可見帶顆粒胞質的較成熟骨髓系細胞，代表芽細胞增加但仍有向顆粒球分化，符合 AML with maturation。
features: Numerous medium to large immature cells with high N:C ratio and finely granular chromatin
Nuclei frequently indented, folded, or irregular; nucleoli indistinct in this smear
Some cells with scant basophilic cytoplasm containing fine azurophilic/pink granules
Maturing myeloid cells present, including a cell with a bilobed nucleus and pale granular cytoplasm and a larger cell with blue-grey granular cytoplasm
Many cells partially disrupted with granular debris in the background (smearing artifact)
1977.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows numerous medium to large immature myeloid cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, finely dispersed chromatin, and frequently indented or folded nuclei; some contain fine azurophilic granules. Maturing granulocytic forms are also present, including cells with bilobed nuclei and granular cytoplasm. Many cells are disrupted, and the background contains granular debris, which limits assessment of nucleoli and Auer rods. Findings are suggestive of acute myeloid leukemia with maturation, which requires a blast count of at least 20% with at least 10% maturing granulocytic cells.

ddx.vs: AML without maturation has blasts constituting at least 90% of non-erythroid cells with less than 10% maturing granulocytes.
APL cells have bilobed, sliding-plate nuclei with dense granules or Auer rod bundles and show PML::RARA; it must be excluded urgently.
MDS with increased blasts has fewer than 20% blasts with prominent multilineage dysplasia.
AMML shows at least 20% monocytic cells with folded nuclei and nonspecific esterase positivity, whereas AML with maturation has fewer than 20% monocytes.

1849.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中混合了芽細胞/前單核球（箭頭所指的大細胞，核折疊、染色質細緻）與大量顆粒球及單核球系細胞，下方中央還有一顆含粗大紫色顆粒的異常嗜酸性球，這種骨髓單核球系增生合併異常嗜酸性球的組合提示 AML 伴 inv(16)。
features: Arrowed large cell with folded/indented nucleus, fine chromatin and moderate grey-blue cytoplasm (blast/promonocyte)
Abnormal eosinophil precursor (lower center) with coarse, dark purple basophilic-staining granules admixed with orange granules
Mixed myelomonocytic population: blasts, monocytoid cells with folded nuclei, and maturing neutrophils
Numerous segmented and band neutrophils indicating some granulocytic maturation
Hypercellular aspirate background with scattered erythrocytes
1849.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular specimen with a mixed myelomonocytic population. Large blasts and promonocytes with folded nuclei, fine chromatin and moderate grey-blue cytoplasm (arrow) are admixed with monocytoid cells and maturing neutrophils. An eosinophil precursor with abnormally large, dark purple (basophilic-staining) granules is present. Findings are consistent with acute myelomonocytic leukemia with abnormal eosinophils, as seen in AML with inv(16)(p13.1q22)/CBFB::MYH11; confirmation requires cytogenetic or molecular testing.

ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps, but lacks the abnormal eosinophils with basophilic granules and is negative for inv(16)/t(16;16) by karyotype, FISH or RT-PCR.
Shows blasts with long slender Auer rods, perinuclear hofs and salmon-colored granules rather than a monocytic component with abnormal eosinophils.
Blasts plus promonocytes are below 20% and there is persistent peripheral monocytosis, whereas inv(16) defines AML regardless of blast count.
Eosinophils have normal orange granules and blasts/promonocytes are not increased.

exam.answer_en: AML with inv(16)/CBFB::MYH11 — mixed myelomonocytic blasts/promonocytes (arrow) with an abnormal eosinophil bearing coarse dark basophilic-staining granules
pearls_zh: 考法：箭頭指的是核折疊、染色質細緻的大細胞，考官問「是 blast 還是 monocyte？」答 blast/promonocyte（染色質細緻），再指下方中央的異常嗜伊紅球推到 inv(16)。
此圖仍有不少成熟中性球，不代表排除 AML；重點是母細胞（含前單核球）比例與 CBFB::MYH11 檢測結果。
判讀母細胞系別：MPO 陽性支持顆粒球分化，NSE（α-naphthyl butyrate esterase）陽性且可被 fluoride 抑制支持單核球分化；AMML 兩者皆有。
CBF-AML 預後佳，誘導後以 high-dose cytarabine 鞏固；治療後追蹤 CBFB::MYH11 轉錄本做 MRD。
分類：WHO 5th 定為 AML with CBFB::MYH11 fusion，不需 20% 母細胞；ICC 2022 需 ≥10%。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤為 AML with t(8;21)；t(8;21) 母細胞大、核周亮區明顯、常有單根細長 Auer rod，雖可有嗜伊紅球但無異常大嗜鹼性顆粒，也少有單核球成分。

quiz.q: 箭頭所指核折疊、染色質細緻的大細胞應歸類為成熟單核球還是母細胞等價物？為什麼？
quiz.a: 母細胞/前單核球（blast equivalent）；染色質細緻未凝集，計入母細胞比例。

1785.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片可見多染性大紅血球、有核紅血球（上方深染小核與左下方嗜鹼性母紅血球），左上箭頭所指的大紅血球內有Howell-Jolly小體，右側箭頭為淡灰藍、輪廓不規則的多染性紅血球，符合新生兒溶血時的紅血球生成反應。
features: Large polychromatophilic red cells, including one containing a Howell-Jolly body (thin arrow)
Pale blue-gray, irregularly outlined polychromatophilic red cell (thick arrow)
Nucleated red cells: a small orthochromatic normoblast and an early normoblast with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and fine chromatin (lower left)
Other large immature-appearing mononuclear cells with coarse chromatin, likely erythroid precursors or lymphocytes
Macrocytic red cell background with anisocytosis; no spherocytes clearly evident at this field
1785.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows anisocytosis with numerous large polychromatophilic red cells, one containing a Howell-Jolly body (thin arrow), and a pale, irregular polychromatophilic cell (thick arrow). Nucleated red cells are present, including an orthochromatic normoblast and an early normoblast with deeply basophilic cytoplasm. Spherocytes are not prominent in this field. Findings are consistent with a brisk erythropoietic response with circulating erythroid precursors, as seen in hemolytic disease of the fetus and newborn.

ddx.vs: Healthy newborns have macrocytosis and a few nucleated red cells, but not the degree of normoblastemia and polychromasia seen in hemolytic disease, which is confirmed by a positive DAT.
Hyposplenism shows Howell-Jolly bodies with target cells and acanthocytes but without marked polychromasia or early normoblasts.

ddx.dx: Congenital dyserythropoietic anemia or megaloblastic anemia
ddx.vs: These show dysplastic or megaloblastic erythroid precursors with inappropriately low reticulocyte response rather than brisk polychromasia.

1721.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中一顆細胞含兩個分開、大小相近的細胞核，染色質粗糙團塊狀，細胞質中等量、呈深藍色且邊緣較深染，屬於雙核的反應性淋巴球樣細胞；型態上無法直接判定是否為非整倍體（aneuploid），標題需配合細胞遺傳學解讀。
features: Single binucleate cell larger than surrounding red cells
Two separate, similarly sized round nuclei with coarsely clumped chromatin; no distinct nucleoli
Moderate amount of deeply basophilic cytoplasm, darker at the periphery, with a pale perinuclear zone
Smooth oval cell outline; no granules or vacuoles
Normocytic red cells with occasional irregular forms in the background
1721.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a binucleate cell with two separate, similarly sized nuclei containing coarsely clumped chromatin and a moderate rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm with peripheral accentuation. No nucleoli, granules, or vacuoles are seen. The appearance resembles a binucleate reactive (plasmacytoid) lymphocyte, a cell that may result from abnormal mitosis or failed cytokinesis. Ploidy cannot be determined from morphology; the designation 'aneuploid cell' requires cytogenetic or DNA content correlation, so the image only partially supports the title.

ddx.vs: Plasma cells have eccentric nuclei with clock-face chromatin and a distinct paranuclear hof in more abundant cytoplasm.
A telophase cell shows a cleavage furrow with condensed chromosomes pulling toward opposite poles rather than two fully reconstituted interphase nuclei.
Overlapping cells show two separate cytoplasmic outlines, whereas this cell has a single continuous cell membrane.
Reed-Sternberg cells are much larger with vesicular chromatin and huge eosinophilic macronucleoli and are not found in peripheral blood.

1593.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中央一顆約為紅血球兩倍大的細胞，核分成3至4葉並以細絲相連，染色質粗塊狀，細胞質淡粉紅並有細小紫紅顆粒，是典型的分葉核中性球（segmented neutrophil）。
features: Cell about twice the diameter of a red cell
Nucleus segmented into 3-4 lobes connected by thin chromatin strands
Coarsely clumped dark chromatin without nucleoli
Pale pink cytoplasm with fine lilac (secondary) granules
Background red cells with central pallor, some overlapping, and scattered platelets
1593.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a mature neutrophil with a nucleus divided into three to four lobes joined by thin filaments, coarsely clumped chromatin and pale cytoplasm containing fine lilac granules. There is no toxic granulation, Döhle body, vacuolization or hypersegmentation. Background red cells show normal central pallor with some overlap, and platelets are present. Findings are consistent with a normal segmented neutrophil.

ddx.vs: A band has a curved nucleus of uniform width without filamentous constrictions, whereas this nucleus is separated into distinct lobes by thin strands.
Hypersegmentation requires six or more lobes (or >5% with five lobes), whereas this cell has three to four lobes.
Eosinophils are usually bilobed with coarse refractile orange-red granules, unlike the fine lilac granules here.

exam.answer_en: Normal segmented neutrophil — 3–4 nuclear lobes joined by thin chromatin filaments, fine lilac secondary granules
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指中央細胞問名稱，關鍵在核葉間是否以細絲（filament）相連；有細絲為 segmented，核寬度一致無縊縮為 band。
ANC <1.5×10^9/L 為 neutropenia、<0.5×10^9/L 為 severe；若合併發燒（febrile neutropenia）屬急症，需立即採血培養並給廣效抗生素。
反應性變化（toxic granulation、Döhle body、cytoplasmic vacuoles）提示感染、發炎或 G-CSF 使用；本圖沒有這些變化，寫答案時可註明 no toxic change。
過度分葉判讀：≥1 顆 6 葉或 5 葉細胞 >5%，常見於 B12/folate 缺乏；單看一顆 4 葉細胞不能下此結論。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常被誤認為 band neutrophil；band 核呈 C/S 形且寬度一致，本細胞核葉間有細絲分隔，應判為 segmented。

quiz.q: 圖中央細胞的名稱是什麼？判斷它不是 band 的依據？
quiz.a: Segmented neutrophil；核葉之間以細絲相連（有 filament）

1465.recognize_zh: 這是間期 FISH 的示意圖（非型態圖）：藍色 DAPI 染色的細胞核內出現三個洋紅色探針訊號，代表該染色體區域多一份拷貝；在 CLL 的標準 FISH 組合中，這種模式即為 12 號染色體三體（trisomy 12）。
features: Schematic interphase FISH illustration rather than a photographed cell
Single round nucleus counterstained blue (DAPI)
Three discrete magenta signals from one probe within the nucleus
Three copies of a single-locus or centromeric probe indicate a trisomy (normal = two signals)
No second-color control probe is shown
1465.describe_en: This is a non-morphologic schematic of interphase fluorescence in situ hybridization. A single DAPI-counterstained nucleus contains three magenta signals from one probe, whereas a normal diploid nucleus would show two. In the chronic lymphocytic leukemia FISH panel (13q14, 11q22/ATM, 17p13/TP53, centromere 12), three signals with the chromosome 12 centromeric probe indicate trisomy 12, which carries intermediate prognosis and is associated with atypical morphology and CD38 expression. Interpretation requires scoring many nuclei against a laboratory cutoff.

60281.recognize_zh: 許多紅血球縮小、染色深且缺乏中央淡染區，血紅素不均勻地集中在細胞一側，另一側呈透明空泡狀（hemighost / blister cells），並有不規則收縮細胞（irregularly contracted cells），符合 G6PD 缺乏的氧化性溶血。
features: Numerous small, dense, irregularly contracted red cells lacking central pallor
Hemighost/blister cells with hemoglobin retracted to one side and a clear, empty membrane remnant on the other
Occasional ghost-like pale cells and spherocytic forms
Many crenated (echinocytic) red cells
Platelets numerous; a lymphocyte and a neutrophil at the field edges
60281.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked poikilocytosis with many irregularly contracted red cells that are small, dense and lack central pallor, with hemoglobin condensed unevenly within the cell. Numerous hemighost (blister) cells show hemoglobin retracted to one side, leaving a clear membrane-bound space, and occasional pale ghost cells and spherocytic forms are present. Crenated cells are also common. Findings are consistent with acute oxidative hemolysis, as in G6PD deficiency after an oxidant exposure; a G6PD assay may be falsely normal during acute hemolysis, and a Heinz body preparation can help.

ddx.vs: Spherocytes are uniformly round with smooth contour, whereas irregularly contracted cells have uneven, eccentric hemoglobin and coexist with hemighosts; DAT separates immune hemolysis.
Unstable hemoglobins also cause Heinz bodies and bite cells but are chronic with a normal G6PD assay and abnormal isopropanol stability or globin sequencing.
Artifactual echinocytes retain even hemoglobin distribution and lack the eccentric clear blister spaces seen here.
MAHA shows fragments with straight edges and thrombocytopenia, whereas this smear shows intact contracted cells and hemighosts with abundant platelets.

exam.answer_en: Acute oxidative hemolysis (G6PD deficiency) — irregularly contracted dense cells and hemighost/blister cells with hemoglobin retracted to one side
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指血紅素集中於一側、另一側透明的細胞（hemighost／blister cell）及不規則收縮細胞，問病因與觸發因子。
G6PD deficiency 為 X-linked；常見誘因：感染、蠶豆（favism）、primaquine、dapsone、rasburicase、磺胺類藥物。台灣新生兒篩檢已納入 G6PD。
急性溶血期 G6PD 活性可假性正常（網狀紅血球酵素較高），應在溶血後約 2–3 個月重驗或做家族檢查。
Heinz bodies 需 supravital stain（如 crystal violet、new methylene blue）才看得到，Wright 染色不可見；脾臟移除 Heinz body 形成 bite cells。
臨床連結：G6PD 缺乏者發生 methemoglobinemia 時 methylene blue 無效且可能加重溶血；使用 rasburicase 前應先確認 G6PD。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 spherocytes（HS 或 warm AIHA）：不規則收縮細胞外形不圓、血紅素分布不均，並伴 hemighost／bite cells；spherocyte 為規則圓形均勻深染。DAT 陰性也支持氧化性溶血。

quiz.q: 此病人在急性溶血當下驗 G6PD 活性正常，能否排除 G6PD 缺乏？為什麼？
quiz.a: 不能；急性期老化紅血球已溶解、網狀紅血球酵素活性高，可假性正常，需數月後重驗

121.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片可見多個大顆粒淋巴球（LGL：核圓或腎形、染色質成熟、淡藍色豐富細胞質內有細小嗜天青顆粒），流式細胞儀顯示一群 CD3 陰性、CD2+/CD7+、CD5 陰性、CD4/CD8 陰性、CD56 弱陽性且 CD57 強陽性的 NK 細胞約佔淋巴球 40%，支持 NK 細胞慢性淋巴增生性疾患（CLPD-NK）。
features: Large granular lymphocytes: medium-sized cells with round to reniform mature nuclei and abundant pale blue cytoplasm containing fine azurophilic granules
Low N:C ratio with condensed chromatin and no visible nucleoli (no blastic or atypical features)
Background red cells include macro-ovalocytes and occasional poikilocytes; one hypersegmented-appearing neutrophil, in keeping with the macrocytic anemia
Flow: lymphocytes 42.9% of events; CD3+ T cells only 22.6% of living cells, with a large CD3-negative, CD2+, CD7+ population (CD7+CD3- 40.6% of lymphocytes)
The CD3-negative population is CD5-negative, CD4-negative, CD8 negative to dim, CD56 dim and CD57 bright (CD57+CD56+ 41.2%)
Residual CD3+ T cells show normal CD5, CD7, CD2 and mixed CD4/CD8 expression, with a CD57+ subset
121.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a relative lymphocytosis composed predominantly of large granular lymphocytes with round to indented mature nuclei and abundant pale cytoplasm containing fine azurophilic granules; blasts and atypical large lymphoid cells are not seen. Red cells show macro-ovalocytes with mild poikilocytosis, and a hypersegmented-appearing neutrophil is present. Flow cytometry identifies an expanded population (~40% of lymphocytes) of surface CD3-negative lymphocytes that express CD2, CD7, dim CD56 and bright CD57 and lack CD5 and CD4, with CD8 negative to dim; the residual T cells have a normal immunophenotype. Findings are consistent with a chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells in the appropriate clinical setting of persistent NK lymphocytosis; evidence of clonality or restriction (e.g., KIR/CD158 isoform restriction, CD94/NKG2A, STAT3 mutation) and exclusion of reactive causes are recommended.

ddx.vs: T-LGL cells are morphologically identical but are surface CD3+ (usually CD8+, CD57+) with clonal TCR rearrangement, whereas the LGLs here are surface CD3-negative NK cells.

Aggressive NK-cell leukemia shows atypical, often larger cells with nucleoli, is EBV-positive, typically CD56 bright and CD57 negative, and presents with fulminant systemic illness, unlike this indolent CD57-bright population in an elderly patient.

Reactive expansions (viral infection, post-splenectomy, autoimmune disease) are transient and show polyclonal KIR expression, so persistence >6 months and KIR restriction or STAT3 mutation are needed to separate it from CLPD-NK.

Hairy cells have circumferential hair-like projections without azurophilic granules and are CD19/CD20+, CD11c+, CD25+, CD103+ B cells, whereas these granular cells are CD2+/CD7+ NK cells lacking B-cell markers.

captions: PB smear: large granular lymphocyte with reniform nucleus and azurophilic granules; macro-ovalocytes in background
PB smear: hypersegmented-appearing neutrophil among macro-ovalocytes
PB smear: two large granular lymphocytes with abundant pale cytoplasm and fine azurophilic granules
Flow, CD45 vs SSC: lymphocyte gate 42.88%, monocytes 1.00%, blasts 0.13%
Flow, CD3 vs SSC: CD3+ T cells only 22.63% of living cells, with a large CD3-negative lymphoid population
Flow, CD3 vs CD5: CD3-negative population (green) lacks CD5; T cells (blue) CD3+CD5+
Flow, CD3 vs CD7: CD7+CD3- lymphocytes 40.63%
Flow, CD7 vs CD2: NK population (green) co-expresses CD2 and CD7; B cells (magenta) negative
Flow, CD5 vs CD7: NK cells CD7+ CD5-negative; T cells CD5+
Flow, CD3 vs CD2: CD2+ CD3-negative NK population
Flow, CD8 vs CD4: NK population negative for CD4 and CD8 (at most dim CD8); T cells show CD4 and CD8 subsets
Flow, CD56 vs CD57: CD57+CD56+ population 41.22% with dim CD56
Flow, CD3 vs CD57: bright CD57 on CD3-negative NK cells, plus a CD57+ T-cell subset

exam.answer_en: Chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells — expanded large granular lymphocytes with azurophilic granules; CD3−, CD2+/CD7+, CD56 dim, CD57 bright
pearls_zh: 考法：血片指著胞質豐富含細小嗜天青顆粒的大顆粒淋巴球（LGL），再以流式問 T-LGL 還是 NK 來源（CD3 表面陰性即 NK）。
NK 細胞無 TCR 重排，克隆性難證明；以 KIR（CD158）限制性表現、CD94/NKG2A 異常或 STAT3 突變作為替代證據。
WHO 5th 稱 NK-large granular lymphocytic leukemia，ICC 2022 保留 CLPD-NK；病程惰性，可合併中性球低下、貧血與自體免疫病。
須與 aggressive NK-cell leukemia 區分：後者病程猛爆、EBV 陽性、多見於亞洲年輕人，常伴 HLH。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤判為 T-LGL leukemia 或病毒感染後反應性 NK 增生；T-LGL 表面 CD3+、CD8+ 且 TCR 克隆，反應性者短暫且無 KIR 限制。

quiz.q: 流式上 CD3 表面陰性、CD56/CD57 陽性的 LGL 增生，要用什麼證明克隆性？
quiz.a: KIR（CD158）限制性表現、STAT3 突變等替代指標

57.recognize_zh: 淋巴結結構消失，由小到中型、胞質透明的淋巴球與豐富分支小血管混合浸潤；免疫染色顯示 CD21/CD23 類濾泡樹突細胞網向濾泡外擴張，腫瘤性 T 細胞表現 CD10、PD-1、CXCL13（TFH 表型），流式可見 CD5+CD10+ T 細胞群，符合血管免疫母細胞性 T 細胞淋巴瘤（AITL）。
features: Effaced lymph node architecture with infiltrate extending into perinodal fat
Polymorphous infiltrate of small-to-medium lymphocytes with abundant clear cytoplasm and mildly irregular nuclei
Prominent arborizing high endothelial venules; admixed histiocytes, plasma cells and scattered large immunoblasts
Irregular, expanded extrafollicular follicular dendritic cell meshworks around vessels
Neoplastic T cells CD3+/CD4+/CD5+ with CD10, PD-1 and CXCL13 (TFH) expression; CD8+ cells are small reactive cells
Scattered EBER-positive cells and large CD20+ B blasts in the background
57.describe_en: Sections of lymph node show effacement of the normal architecture by a diffuse polymorphous infiltrate that extends into perinodal adipose tissue, with residual B-cell areas compressed toward the periphery. At higher power the infiltrate consists of small-to-medium lymphocytes with abundant clear cytoplasm, admixed with prominent arborizing high endothelial venules, histiocytes, other inflammatory cells and scattered large immunoblasts, including occasional mitoses. Immunohistochemistry shows sheets of CD3+, CD4+, CD5+ T cells co-expressing CD10, PD-1 and CXCL13, with scattered CD20+ large B cells, CD8+ small reactive T cells, irregular expanded follicular dendritic cell meshworks outside follicles, scattered large cells highlighted by an unlabeled membranous/Golgi stain (likely CD30), and scattered EBER-positive cells by in situ hybridization. Flow cytometry identifies a CD5+ CD10+ CD19- T-cell population. Findings are consistent with angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma (nodal T-follicular helper cell lymphoma, angioimmunoblastic type).

ddx.vs: Scattered CD30+/PAX5+ large cells can mimic Hodgkin cells, but AITL shows an abnormal CD10+/PD-1+ TFH T-cell population with expanded FDC meshworks and T-cell clonality, which cHL lacks.
PTCL-NOS lacks expression of at least two TFH markers (CD10, PD-1, CXCL13, BCL6, ICOS) and does not show the extrafollicular FDC expansion and arborizing HEVs typical of AITL.

ddx.dx: Reactive paracortical hyperplasia / drug or viral lymphadenopathy
ddx.vs: Reactive nodes preserve sinuses and follicles, lack clear-cell TFH cells outside follicles, and show no CD10+ T-cell population by flow or monoclonal TCR rearrangement.

Here the large B cells are scattered EBV-associated bystanders while the neoplastic population is a CD10+/PD-1+ T-cell population, whereas THRLBCL has monoclonal large B cells in a background of non-TFH reactive T cells and histiocytes.

57.stain: H&E; IHC panel (CD3, CD10, PD-1, CXCL13); ISH: EBER; flow
captions: H&E, medium power: diffuse polymorphous infiltrate of clear-cytoplasm lymphocytes with numerous small vessels
H&E, low power: effaced node with infiltrate extending into perinodal fat
H&E, high power: clear-cell atypical lymphocytes, high endothelial venules, immunoblasts and a mitotic figure
CD20 (low and high power) and CD3: peripherally compressed B-cell areas with scattered large B cells; CD3+ atypical T cells
Unlabeled FDC marker (e.g. CD21/CD23): irregular expanded extrafollicular dendritic cell meshworks around vessels
CD4, CD5 and CD8: atypical T cells CD4+/CD5+; CD8 marks small reactive T cells
CD10, PD-1 and CXCL13: TFH marker expression by neoplastic T cells
Flow cytometry: CD5+ CD10+ CD19- T-cell population (open arrow) and a small CD19+ B-cell population (arrow)
Unlabeled IHC (likely CD30): scattered large cells with membranous and Golgi-type staining
EBER in situ hybridization: scattered EBV-positive cells

exam.answer_en: Angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma (nodal TFH cell lymphoma, AITL type) — clear-cell TFH T cells (CD10/PD-1/CXCL13+) with arborizing HEVs and expanded FDC meshworks
pearls_zh: 考法：考官會指胞質透明的中小型淋巴球與分支狀高內皮小靜脈問診斷，或問 CD21/CD23 顯示濾泡外擴張的 FDC 網代表什麼。
TFH 標記：PD-1、ICOS、CXCL13、BCL6、CD10；WHO 5th 更名為 nodal T-follicular helper cell lymphoma, angioimmunoblastic type。
分子：TET2、DNMT3A、RHOA G17V、IDH2 R172 突變常見；背景可有 EBER+ B immunoblasts。
臨床：B 症狀、皮疹、全身淋巴結腫大、多株性高丙種球蛋白血症、Coombs 陽性溶血；可合併繼發 EBV+ B 細胞淋巴瘤。
exam.pitfall_zh: 多形性背景加 EBV+ B 大細胞易誤診為反應性增生、cHL 或 B 細胞淋巴瘤（B 細胞克隆性亦可陽性）；關鍵是找出帶 TFH 表型的異常 T 細胞與 TCR 克隆性。

quiz.q: AITL 中哪個染色可顯示濾泡外、圍繞血管擴張的 FDC 網？
quiz.a: CD21（或 CD23）

3577.recognize_zh: 一顆大型、胞質灰藍且缺乏顆粒的細胞內含十多個大小不一的圓形深紫色核碎片（核碎裂 karyorrhexis 樣），旁有數顆未成熟髓系細胞；依標題解讀為顆粒球發育不良的核碎裂，但也需排除凋亡細胞或吞噬碎片的巨噬細胞。
features: Large cell with gray-blue, largely agranular cytoplasm
Numerous round, dense, dark purple nuclear fragments of varying size scattered in the cytoplasm (karyorrhexis-like)
Adjacent immature myeloid cells with fine chromatin and pale gray cytoplasm
Red cells show crenation and refractile 'water artifact' holes from slow drying
Small platelet clump at lower left
3577.describe_en: Smear (likely bone marrow aspirate) shows a large cell with gray-blue, essentially agranular cytoplasm containing numerous round, dense nuclear fragments of variable size, accompanied by several immature myeloid cells. Red cells show drying artifact with refractile holes and crenation. In the context of dysgranulopoiesis, the cell is interpreted as a dysplastic granulocytic precursor with nuclear fragmentation and hypogranularity. However, a single fragmented cell is not specific, and an apoptotic cell or a macrophage containing ingested nuclear debris cannot be excluded without evaluating additional fields.

ddx.vs: Apoptotic neutrophils are normal-sized with shrunken pink granular cytoplasm and a few dense round nuclear fragments, rather than a large agranular cell.

ddx.dx: Macrophage with ingested apoptotic bodies (tingible-body macrophage)
ddx.vs: A macrophage retains its own separate reniform nucleus and shows vacuolated cytoplasm around ingested debris.
Dyserythropoietic cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm and nuclear buds or internuclear bridging, and they lack granulocytic features.

61625.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片可見明顯紅血球大小不等與異形（anisopoikilocytosis）：混有正常色與淡染的紅血球、靶形細胞、橢圓形與淚滴狀紅血球及棘狀細胞；環形鐵粒母細胞只能在骨髓鐵染色看到，本圖僅提供支持性的紅血球異常線索。
features: Marked anisopoikilocytosis with target cells, elliptocytes, teardrop cells and an occasional echinocyte/acanthocyte
Suggestion of a dimorphic red cell population with some paler, hypochromic cells among normochromic cells
Leukocytes present are mature-appearing: small lymphocytes and a cell with moderate cytoplasm and coarse nucleus
Platelets adequate in this field with some variation in size
Ring sideroblasts are not assessable on peripheral blood
61625.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis, including target cells, elliptocytes, teardrop cells, and occasional echinocytes, with a suggestion of a dimorphic population in which some red cells appear paler than others. The few leukocytes in the field are mature lymphocytes without obvious blasts, and platelets appear adequate. These red cell changes are nonspecific; ring sideroblasts must be demonstrated on an iron-stained bone marrow aspirate. In the appropriate clinical context, the findings are compatible with the peripheral blood picture of myelodysplastic syndrome with ring sideroblasts.

ddx.vs: Iron deficiency shows uniformly microcytic hypochromic cells and pencil cells with low ferritin and absent marrow iron, without ring sideroblasts.

ddx.dx: Congenital sideroblastic anemia or acquired non-clonal sideroblastic anemia (alcohol, copper deficiency, drugs)
ddx.vs: These also produce dimorphic red cells and ring sideroblasts, so separation requires history, copper/B6 levels, and SF3B1 mutation or cytogenetic evidence of clonality.
Thalassemia shows microcytosis with high RBC count and numerous target cells, normal iron stores, and abnormal hemoglobin studies rather than a dimorphic population.
